title: How Stress Affects Weight Health and Daily Well-Being

authorship.current_visible_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team
authorship.recommended_normalized_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team

primary_question: How does chronic stress affect weight, eating behavior, and daily well-being?
reader_intent: Understand the cortisol/stress-eating cycle and adopt evidence-based stress-management strategies.
desired_reader_outcome: Reader understands the stress-cortisol-eating cycle and adopts mindfulness/movement/sleep/connection strategies.

claims.proposition: Chronically elevated cortisol promotes abdominal fat storage and increases appetite for calorie-dense foods.
claims.article_location: "What Happens to Your Body Under Stress?" section
claims.recommended_action: Standard, well-established stress endocrinology; zero citation given, but appropriately hedged and directionally consistent with the corpus's other cortisol-related claims (hormones-and-weight-beyond-calories-in-calories-out).

disposition_reason: Well-hedged, distinct, practically useful stress-management content; the one mechanism claim made is standard and consistent with other corpus content even though uncited — not severe enough to block KEEP given the qualitative, non-specific-numeric framing.
